title: Enterprise Connectivity: ordinary portfolio aggregation
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs ordinary portfolio aggregation for service charge.

## Superseded scope 1
The following ordinary clause is no longer in force within the applicable assisted routes for accepted-source pricing; net transfer invoice. It remains the ordinary basis outside those specifically defined routes. Retired within that scope: Use undiscounted monthly portfolio usage subtotal to select the portfolio discount.

## Policy clause 2
Combine only holdings of this category owned by the same customer with the same legal billing entity and source period, even if some have since closed.

## Policy clause 3
No cross-entity or cross-category spending counts.

## Superseded scope 4
The following ordinary clause is no longer in force within the applicable assisted routes for accepted-source pricing; net transfer invoice. It remains the ordinary basis outside those specifically defined routes. Retired within that scope: The threshold comparison is inclusive.

## Superseded scope 5
The following ordinary clause is no longer in force within the applicable assisted routes for accepted-source pricing; net transfer invoice. It remains the ordinary basis outside those specifically defined routes. Retired within that scope: Portfolio discount applies only to primary service usage and only if no higher-priority price applies; it is neither a cash credit nor a deduction from ancillary service fees.

## Measurement basis
The source period, a UTC calendar month; customer and legal billing entity match the proposed charge. Sum posted primary meter quantities net of meter reversal by holding, multiply each interval by its applicable standard tier standard unit price and region factor without any discount or tax, and sum across this category. Exclude ancillary meters and never sum already discounted invoices.

## Points of judgement
No cross-entity or cross-category spending counts.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the portfolio spending threshold, portfolio reduction fraction, invoice grouping used by this rule.
